0022600098.text: The Pistons, 1-0 and first in the Central, visit the 0-1 Miami Heat, who are fifth in the Southeast, one game back, for Detroit's second game of the season and the first meeting between the teams in 2026-27. Detroit enters on a one-game winning streak, while Miami is coming off a one-game losing streak. In 2025-26 the Pistons lost 1-2 to Miami, including a 121-110 loss in Miami on March 8, 2026.
